mandate: Assess a seed software investment strictly from admitted historical evidence. Publisher technical claims are not independent performance or customer verification. Preserve essential business unknowns and do not infer failure from absence of data.
source_selection: Previously admitted fixed original-cohort package candidate; no outcomes used; not a holdout or representative sample
input_policy: Exact same QA rows, company identity, mandate and cutoff for both arms; no retrieval
measures: Execution and stop status for every arm, including failures
Budget reservations, physical CLI attempts when available, elapsed time
Citation membership in admitted fact set
Reviewer-bound source-support assessment, distinct from citation validity
review_rules: README product/performance claims remain attributed to publisher, not independent proof
Document links and dynamic badge URLs do not establish fetched content or historical metrics
Unknown customer, revenue and retention facts do not become negative outcomes
No company/category facts supplied from model memory
excluded_claims: No predictive accuracy, financial return or population-level comparison
No causal proof from one case and different role/prompt bundles
No independent human gold or proven exclusion of pretrained future knowledge
